item.title: SI Radio Officially Moves To Discord
item.description: As of Sunday July 8 2018 Split Infinity Radio officially moved all chat communications to Discord. The IRC server has been officially decommissioned and is no longer able to be connected to. The chat page has been updated to reflect this and contains a link to the Discord server. If you have difficulties on connecting please feel free to reach out to numbers1thru9@siradio.fmfor assistance. You can also click the following link to get to the server:https://discord.gg/y3QMm2k

item.title: The Cullin 2 has tanked so hard, its no longer for sale
item.description: The Culling 2released last week and, right away, it tanked. According to the studio’s YouTube video announcement today, anyone who purchased the $20 game across Xbox One, PS4, and PC is eligible for a refund. item.title: Want to listen to the stream?
item.description: UPDATE: THE PLAYER AT THE TOP WORKS AGAIN! A while back we switched the website to use https instead of http. Due to this change unfortunately the player at the top of the screen does not function. However, that does not mean we are dead! We live on! You can still use VLC on PC and mobile devices to tune into the stream with the other buttons or you can use TuneIn on your mobile devices. Of course we still have discord and Wasabi can stream to there as well! Hop on in and say hi!
